budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Repair both facilities to four units by transporting and installing limited cables, switches and batteries. Every crew member receives total actual repair increment divided by eight.
task.natural_termination: Both facilities reach four repair units; otherwise time ends at 112 transitions. These task rules are not scientific performance gates.
task.interaction: Installed cables and switches define a seven-node graph. Enabled batteries supply their actual connected components. Demand exceeding three units per available battery trips the component. Node 6 opens the gate; nodes 4 and 5 power repair tools. Specialty-limited installation and physical handoff make partners change one another inventory, routes and work opportunities.
task.observation_access: All terrain, crew/item positions, modes, carriers, slots, charge, trips, connectivity, node endpoints, power, loads, device modes, progress and gate state are public flat-observation fields. Own specialty and service rate are explicit. All rendered entities are public; static role ordering and capacities are task definitions.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Part installed or retrieved on this transition
Node power changed since input state
Overload detected before discharge and trip resolution on this transition
Courier added one charge by pedaling

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
